ci: 95% percentile; confirmatory only when all 5,000 locked replicates are finite
cluster_rule: unchanged from Stage 05: strongest available source entity; source TEST=row; BanglaClick=stored SOURCE_URL-derived cluster_id; BaitBuster=stored channel_id-derived cluster_id

estimability_policy.bh_rule: BH-FDR is not run on a post-hoc subset of the eight prespecified cue families.
estimability_policy.contrast_rule: Any invalid locked replicate => confirmatory CI/p NON_ESTIMABLE.
estimability_policy.global_rule: All 32 dimensions and all 5,000 joint replicates plus full-rank 32×32 covariance are required.

family_fdr_outcome_full.reason: BH-FDR was not run on a post-hoc subset; at least one prespecified cue-family Simes p-value is unavailable.

family_fdr_reliability_full.reason: BH-FDR was not run on a post-hoc subset; at least one prespecified cue-family Simes p-value is unavailable.
